purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and prompt controls for a low-resource Cetacean Navigator wet/dry berth hearing.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for the Brineglass hearing-room routine, four preparation paths, pressure-channel failure, four responses, shared disposition threshold, and three ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use a separate visual_scene_id for the room, docket routine, each preparation action, the complete trace, the one-sentence pressure-channel failure, each response action, the disposition threshold, and each ending family.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Every base prompt is a complete visible frame for a general image model. Fictional interfaces are described by geometry, materials, lights, water effects, screens, rail movement, and body position. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: humane retro-industrial science-fiction storybook illustration, precise ink linework under translucent gouache color, teal pool light against rust-orange work lamps, readable silhouettes and interfaces, tactile worn materials, restrained facial expression, cinematic composition sized for illustrated interactive fiction.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each render from global_style_cue plus the scene base_image_prompt plus visual refs only for named characters actually listed in visible_characters plus triggered state or global branch modifiers. A camera-specific blockout from the declared scene_set is required for multi-angle website rendering.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The story returns to one wet/dry chamber from wide, side, pool-level, rail-level, and object-closeup cameras. Sightlines, the pressure wall, the sealed drawer, body-specific controls, and dry/wet access affect choices.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Build a durable plan view or simple 3D blockout for Brineglass's berth-hearing chamber using the fixed zones, routes, occluders, camera slots, and staging slots below. Until that exists, the prompts are concept-ready but the fixture is not high-consistency illustrated-replay-ready.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide view from the dry entrance of a long rectangular space-station hearing chamber divided lengthwise by a waist-high pressure wall. The left half is a turquoise orientation pool with shallow entry shelf, deep blue working lane, black acoustic emitter discs, and a low rubberized paddle at dolphin rostrum height. The right half is a grated metal gallery with six folding seats, a waist-high tactile rail, and a compact clerk console. A broad route board spans both halves overhead, projecting white route lines while submerged emitters make visible ripples and small pins rise along the dry rail. A sealed stainless evidence drawer sits beneath the board through the dividing wall. Teal underwater light meets rust-orange task lamps on worn steel, rubber seals, and fogged glass. Sere-in-Return, a slate-gray bottlenose dolphin, swims in the working lane; Mina Osei stands at the console; Halden Roe and Toma Pell wait beside the rail.

visible_characters.default_stance: swimming broadside in the deep working lane, one eye on the board
standing behind the dryside clerk console
upright beside the tactile rail, shoulders held tight
holding a duplicate slate with both hands near the rail

visual_continuity_notes: The pool and dry gallery run parallel along the room, separated by one waist-high pressure wall with no visual break between participants.
The route board spans both zones; the sealed drawer passes through the wall directly below it.

Sere-in-Return circles in the turquoise pool, slate-gray bottlenose body catching teal light. Halden Roe waits in a creased blue carrier coat beside a white berth countdown on the clerk console. Young apprentice Toma Pell grips a duplicate slate by the tactile rail. Rust-orange work lamps expose repaired cable covers and mineral scale around black underwater emitters.

visible_characters.default_stance: circling once in the working lane
one hand feeding the sealed slate into the evidence drawer
waiting close to the berth display

visual_continuity_notes: The evidence drawer stays beneath the route board at the pressure wall.
The berth countdown is part of Mina's console facing both wet and dry participants.

scene_set.room_model: Long rectangular transfer room, roughly twice as long as it is wide, divided lengthwise into an equal-width orientation pool and grated dry gallery by a waist-high pressure wall. The route board and evidence drawer bridge the division at the room midpoint.

fixed_zones.visible_form: turquoise pool occupying half the room width, with shallow entrance shelf, deep central working lane, black submerged emitters, low rostrum paddles, and speaker grille
fixed_zones.used_for: Sere's movement, pressure-pulse access, wet-side pause and disposition controls

fixed_zones.visible_form: waist-high sealed divider with wet inspection windows, rubber coping, and the evidence drawer passing through at midpoint
fixed_zones.used_for: shared sightlines, evidence transfer, and cross-body conversation

fixed_zones.visible_form: grated aisle occupying half the room width, with six folding seats, waist-high tactile rail, dry entrance, and view toward the berth pressure door
fixed_zones.used_for: claimant seating, Toma's rail access, Halden's movement, and cargo-door sightline

fixed_zones.visible_form: broad suspended glass-and-metal board crossing both pool and gallery with white route light, sound bands, diagnostic beads, and synchronized timing marks
fixed_zones.used_for: shared route trace and provenance labels

fixed_zones.visible_form: compact repaired console on the dry gallery at the far end, angled toward both pool and claimant rail, with berth countdown and translation panes
fixed_zones.used_for: Mina's docket, clock, translation, and commit work

fixed_zones.visible_form: stainless sealed drawer beneath the route board with thick rubber seals, wet inspection window, violet slate light, and custody marks
pressure door at the gallery entrance with a narrow reinforced window facing berth indicators and cargo staging
fixed_zones.used_for: participant arrival, cargo consequence, carrier movement, and other-convoy berth transfer

occluders.effect: Blocks the far-end berth window from object-closeup cameras at the evidence drawer but not from wide or gallery cameras.
Blocks lower-body detail across the wet/dry division while preserving faces, dolphin head and back, hands, rail, and board sightlines.

visual_character_refs.purpose: Stable named-character designs for prompt assembly. Include only refs for characters visible in each scene.

characters.sere_in_return: Sere-in-Return: uplifted adult bottlenose dolphin, streamlined slate-gray body with pale underside, three pale diagonal scars along the left jaw that continue faintly behind the eye, dark alert eyes, long rostrum, curved dorsal fin, two pectoral fins, powerful tail flukes, small weathered brass clerk transponder clipped to a soft band immediately behind the dorsal fin. Body language uses swimming depth, broadside or head-on orientation, roll, eye alignment, rostrum contact, fin angle, stillness, and distance from the wall. Do-not-change details: anatomically complete slate-gray bottlenose silhouette, three left-jaw scars, brass dorsal transponder.
characters.mina_osei: Mina Osei: baseline human dryside docket clerk, compact middle-aged Black woman, close-cropped natural hair threaded with gray, rectangular amber reading lenses, worn rust-orange station vest over a charcoal pressure-work shirt, black utility trousers, soft-soled deck boots, broad capable hands with violet seal ink at two fingertips. Posture is economical and patient at the console. Do-not-change details: orange vest, amber lenses, gray-threaded close hair, violet-stained fingertips.
characters.halden_roe: Captain Halden Roe: baseline human Lightsail Express carrier captain, tall lean middle-aged man with brown skin, close-cropped silver hair, narrow lined face, creased cobalt-blue carrier coat over a gray work layer, small silver ledger emblem at the left chest, dark deck shoes. Controlled posture compresses impatience into tight shoulders and precise hand placement. Do-not-change details: silver close hair, creased cobalt coat, silver ledger emblem, no military insignia.
characters.toma_pell: Toma Pell: baseline human young-adult carrier apprentice, wiry build, olive skin, thick dark curls tied away from the face, gray carrier undershirt with rolled sleeves, mustard-yellow apprentice sash across the torso, black work trousers, scuffed deck shoes, flat duplicate witness slate usually held with both hands. Curiosity appears through open palms, forward lean, and quick gaze between interfaces. Do-not-change details: dark curls, yellow sash, rolled gray sleeves, duplicate slate.

groups.cargo_handlers: Cargo handlers: two baseline human station workers in lime pressure vests over charcoal work shirts, black utility trousers, gray work gloves, soft deck boots, pushing a low cargo dolly loaded with sealed rectangular food cases and cylindrical clinic-filter canisters.

review_notes: A textual scene-set specification records layout, routes, occluders, camera slots, staging slots, and branch-visible anchors.

A durable plan view or 3D blockout is still required before high-consistency multi-angle website rendering; current prompts are standalone concept frames and the plan does not claim replay-ready geometry.
All character refs use visible body-specific stance and are included only when those characters appear in frame.
